title: DPDPA, RBI & SEBI — India's three-layer digital compliance stack
summary: **DPDPA** (2023) — India's first comprehensive data protection law; penalties up to ₹250 cr (security failure) + ₹200 cr (breach notification failure).

items: **DPDPA** (2023) — India's first comprehensive data protection law; penalties up to ₹250 cr (security failure) + ₹200 cr (breach notification failure).
RBI Master Directions on IT Governance (2023, eff. Apr 2024) — 2FA mandatory for digital payments.
**SEBI CSCRF** (2024) — 22 types of regulated entities, five-tier model.
FY25: RBI imposed ₹54.78 cr penalties across 353 cases for governance/cybersecurity lapses.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Three-regulator stack — don't confuse jurisdictions (DPDPA=all entities / RBI IT Directions=BFSI / SEBI CSCRF=market intermediaries).
